prompt: What was the final league position of the football team found in the city where José Loiola won his first World Championship gold medal for the season which began in that same year when he won gold?
answer: José Loiola won his first World Championship gold in **Marseille in 1999**. The city’s football club, **Olympique de Marseille**, finished **15th in Ligue 1** in the 1999–2000 season.
